# secureaccess_zta_profile_private_access_steering_destination (Resource)

This resource manages a ZTA Profile Private Access Steering Destination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "secureaccess_zta_profile_private_access_steering_destination" "example" {
  zta_profile_id = "acde070d-8c4c-4f0d-9d8a-162843c10333"
  destination    = "internal.example.com"
  exclusions     = ["app.internal.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination` (String) Endpoint to steer privately. FQDN, wildcard FQDN, IP address and CIDR are allowed.
- `zta_profile_id` (String) ID of the ZTA Profile.

### Optional

- `exclusions` (Set of String) Exclusions when `destination` is a wildcard FQDN or CIDR. For a wildcard FQDN, `exclusions` must be sub-domains of the `destination`. For a CIDR, `exclusions` must be subnets of the `destination`.

### Read-Only

- `destination_type` (String) Type of the endpoint, `fqdn` for FQDN and wildcard FQDN, `network` for IP address and CIDR.
- `id` (String) Id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import secureaccess_zta_profile_private_access_steering_destination.example "<zta_profile_id>,<id>"
```
